_doc: Voice budget of the Sfx pool (docs/AUDIO.md, decision 2026-11-08: a 30-player expedition is ~60 animated characters). cap: most one-shot voices sounding at once in each lane (SFX: every near voice, on the clear SFX bus or the SFXWorld bus the downed muffle dulls; SFXFar: far ones; SFXMuffled: sounds behind terrain), a new sound past it steals the lowest-priority voice or is dropped. own_m: a sound this close to the listener is your own (your Hunter, your Boki, a hit on you) and is never stolen. keep: cues that are never stolen wherever they play (warnings, recasts, your hurt, the incoming-hit cue placed at whoever hit you). cheap: name fragments of footsteps and Boki chatter, the first to go when they are far.
cap_unit: voices per lane (Sfx.POOL = 24 plain voices plus 24 placed ones)
